entries.text: Greetings, my little students. Whatever you did\nyesterday, it is now a part of history.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_03_history_01

entries.text: Today, we will continue to unravel the marvels\nthat history has presented to us.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_03_history_02

entries.text: As you should remember from our last class,\nArea Zero’s Great Era of Exploration began\r\nabout two thousand years ago.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_03_history_03

entries.text: This era lasted for approximately one thousand\nyears, but not a single soul was able to venture\r\nall the way to the deepest reaches of Area Zero.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_03_history_04

entries.text: Having poured much of its human and financial\nresources into the exploration of Area Zero for\r\nso long, the Paldean Empire fell into decline.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_03_history_05

entries.text:
Two hundred years later—or eight hundred years
ago—the empire and its surrounding nations
united into one entity.\c
This was the formation of Paldea as we know it
today.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_03_history_06

entries.text: Ah yes, this very academy where you’re now\nfilling your young minds with knowledge was also\r\napparently established at that time.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_03_history_07

entries.text: In fact, this school building—though certainly\nhaving undergone repairs through the years—\r\nis just as it was when it was built so long ago.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_03_history_08

entries.text: This very structure is a piece of history! Ahh!\nThings of old are truly splendid![VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_03_history_09

entries.text: I would certainly prefer it not to have the Poké\nBall portion, though—a relatively new addition.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_03_history_10

entries.text: Aha. Perfect timing to make eye contact, young\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_03_history_11

entries.text: Let’s see if you’ve been listening to my lecture.\c\nTell me—approximately how many years ago\nwas this academy of ours established?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_03_history_12

entries.text: About six hundred years ago
entries.label: class_c_03_select_01

entries.text: About seven hundred years ago
entries.label: class_c_03_select_02

entries.text: About eight hundred years ago
entries.label: class_c_03_select_03

entries.text: Incorrect! You are missing two hundred years of\nsplendid history![VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_03_history_answer_01

entries.text: Incorrect! You are missing one hundred years of\nsplendid history![VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_03_history_answer_02

entries.text:
Correct! I see the look of concentration on your
face was indeed just that.\c
I hate nothing more than when a student only
pretends to listen.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_03_history_answer_03

entries.text: This academy was constructed exactly 805 years\nago, to be precise. In other words, your academy\r\nhere is 805 years old![VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_03_history_13

entries.text: At the time, it offered state-of-the-art facilities\nand a uniquely innovative curriculum. As such,\r\npeople used to say...[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_03_history_14

entries.text:
“Those seeking knowledge need look no further
than the oranges of Paldea.”\c
That’s right—they were referring to Naranja
Academy![VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_03_history_15a

entries.text:
“Those seeking knowledge need look no further
than the grapes of Paldea.”\c
That’s right—they were referring to Uva
Academy![VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_03_history_15b

entries.text: It is said that this proverb of sorts was even used\noutside of the Paldea region.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_03_history_16

entries.text: Oho, is that the time already? I must’ve gotten\nswept up in filling your minds with knowledge.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_03_history_17

entries.text:
This ends today’s lesson. Our next class will be
our midterm exam.\c
Bring the wonders of history to the forefront of
your minds in preparation.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_03_history_18
